consequence_rationale: a gear-shift knob in the driver's hand. A failure is a knob that will not seat or will not slide, not an injury

open_questions.question: the base-plate height is a photo estimate the source notes give as +/-2 mm, and it decides whether the sleeve's mouth seats on the plate or stops short of it. Both answers are modelled here rather than guessed

requirements.name: engagement_length_mm
requirements.note: the lever length the knob has to slide over without a radial obstruction jamming it. Shared by every formulation and changed by none of them

requirements.name: rail_w_mm
requirements.note: the width of the two opposed lever rails

requirements.name: grip_d_mm
requirements.note: a diameter that fills a hand

requirements.name: envelope_z_mm
requirements.note: the tallest the knob may be

reviewer.note: the judgements replayed here were recorded once and are played back; no context answered them during this run
